name: MeerKAT
place: Meerkat National Park, Karoo, Northern Cape
description: A radio telescope of 64 dishes, 13.5 m each, in South Africa's Karoo, run by the South African Radio Astronomy Observatory (SARAO). Originally the Karoo Array Telescope.
highlights: It was officially inaugurated on 13 July 2018 with an image of the region around the supermassive black hole at the centre of the Milky Way.
In 2019 a team using it found balloon-like structures hundreds of light-years tall above and below the galactic centre.
Its 64 dishes will be part of SKA-Mid.
